title: Methadone Versus Standard of Care for Pain Control in Minimally Invasive Lung Resection Surgery
official: Methadone Versus Standard of Care for Pain Control in Minimally Invasive Lung Resection Surgery
summary: This study is being done to find out if methadone is more effective in controlling pain in patients presenting for minimally invasive lung resection surgery compared to the standard of care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Scheduled for minimally-invasive lung resection surgery (for example, wedge, lobe, segmentectomy, combination of aforementioned procedures)
* Elective same day admission cases Exclusion Criteria
* Daily use of \>/= 60 MME for 1 month or greater
* Weight \< 50 kg
* Baseline oxygen requirement
* Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 4 or 5
* Diagnosis of cirrhosis or liver failure
* Left ventricular ejection fraction \< 30%
* Conversion to thoracotomy
